title: Full-Stack Mobile Engineer - Blued
summary: A mobile engineer role for the product team behind StudyIn, Japan’s No. 1 overseas education travel service. The role involves developing mobile apps and backend APIs, and planning/implementing AI agents.
content:
A mobile engineer role for the product team behind StudyIn, Japan’s No. 1 overseas education travel service. The role involves developing mobile apps and backend APIs, and planning/implementing AI agents.

  • Company: Blued
  • Role: Full-Stack Mobile Engineer
  • Location: Tokyo, Japan (Partial Remote)
  • Salary: ¥7M ~ ¥13M /yr
  • Eligibility: 🇯🇵 Residents Only (Must live in Japan)
  • Technology: Cross-platform mobile (Flutter, React Native), backend APIs
  • Domain: Education travel, AI agents (travel management, visa follow-up)
  • Language: Japanese (Business Level), English (Business Level)
